items.briefing:
Australian energy provider Origin has confirmed a data breach exposing customer information — if you're an Origin customer, watch for suspicious emails or calls claiming to be from them. Separately, a new Australian study warns that AI is making ransomware attacks more effective and harder to detect, meaning Australian organisations face a growing threat from these file-locking attacks. A new malware called Dolphin X is also using AI to identify and prioritise high-value targets before striking.

If you receive unexpected contact from Origin or any organisation after a breach, don't click links — go directly to the official website instead.

featured.title: Australian energy provider Origin says data breach exposes client data - BleepingComputer
featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider breached, exposing customer data to potential misuse.
